draft.text: You came in because you were told you might have hepatitis C, but you are waiting for more information.
We found out you were diagnosed with hepatitis C based on a blood test, but no more tests have been done yet.
You may have hepatitis C, but we need more tests to be sure.
You also feel tired at the end of the day, but you don't have other symptoms like nausea or jaundice.
You need to have more tests, like a liver function test and a test to check for the virus.
You should talk to your doctor about next steps and possible treatment.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you were told you have hepatitis C based on a blood test.
You feel fine most of the time but have had some tiredness at the end of the day for a few months.
You have been diagnosed with hepatitis C, but more tests are needed to confirm this and check your liver health.
You will need more tests and will talk to your doctor about next steps and possible treatments.
